title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Improving our help content

Using our support tools

title: Senior Agent Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Technical owner of Proxima’s AI agent platform, turning autonomous agents into reliable everyday colleagues for physicists and engineers.

  • Own the platform architecture, technical delivery, and day-to-day operation.

  • Scale the platform from an early product into reliable, governed infrastructure used across the company.

  • Enable agents to work across knowledge bases, write code, run simulations, and support engineering workflows.

  • Work within the Enterprise AI Team Lead’s overall vision while owning how that vision is technically implemented.

  • Use strong technical judgment to influence and shape the platform roadmap.

  • Identify and propose new platform features based on hands-on experience and feedback from internal users.

  • Build a platform that engineers and scientists can trust for real, production-level work.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the design, delivery, and operation of our agent platform: the runtime and its primitives: durable sessions, sandboxed execution environments, long-running task execution, memory, and tool integration

  • Turn a rapidly evolving agent ecosystem into stable platform building blocks: evaluate harnesses, models, and protocols as they emerge, and decide what becomes a supported primitive versus a passing experiment

  • Co-Design the integration layer that connects agents to internal and external systems, from enterprise tools to our scientific computing stack, and the standards for how tools, skills, and context are exposed to agents

  • Make autonomy safe and governable: permission and approval flows with human-in-the-loop escalation, capability boundaries, audit logging, cost and token controls, and hardening against prompt injection and tool abuse

  • Build the evaluation and observability layer for non-deterministic systems: session tracing, quality evals, and cost/latency visibility, so we know agents work before our users have to find out

  • Operate what you build on Google Cloud with production discipline: reliability, failure handling, and observability

  • Work directly with demanding technical users and feed their feedback and your technical judgment into the platform roadmap you shape together with the team lead

WHO YOU ARE

Must have

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with real depth in Python and distributed backend systems

  • You have architected, built, and operated production-grade agentic or LLM systems well beyond the prototype phase

  • You know the current agent ecosystem hands-on: MCP, agent SDKs and CLIs, multi-agent orchestration patterns, sandboxed code execution and have formed opinions on where the abstractions should sit

  • You have run production workloads on Kubernetes and a major cloud (ideally GCP), and know what it takes to keep stateful, long-running services alive

  • You treat evaluation and observability as platform features, not afterthoughts

  • You take security seriously as a design constraint

  • You think in platforms and internal products

  • You are a low-ego, high-clarity communicator who can work directly with expert users and build consensus across teams

  • You have experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD

Nice to have

  • Experience with model gateways and routing

  • Exposure to scientific or high-performance computing: batch schedulers, HPC clusters, or simulation-heavy environments

  • Open-source contributions to AI/agent tooling

  • A track record of technical mentorship

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Über Greenflash

Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst.

Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Initiative und Ergebnisse. Deshalb geben wir Menschen früh Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben.

Wir wachsen gemeinsam.
Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld.


Deine Mission

  • Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
  • Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen.
  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.


Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du kennst unsere Systemlandschaft und Architektur.
  • Du übernimmst erste eigene Architekturthemen.
  • Du bringst dich als Sparringspartner in die Entwicklung ein.
  • Du triffst erste Architekturentscheidungen und setzt Impulse.
  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelandschaft aktiv mit.


Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
  • Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
  • Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
  • Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.


Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. 
  • Ein Team mit Ambition
    Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.
  • Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise
    Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.
  • Erfolge gemeinsam erleben
    Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören.

Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
  • Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
  • Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
  • KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
  • Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
  • Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
  • Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: 
     Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.


Deine Benefits

  • New Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.
  • Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.
  • Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.
  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.
  • Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.

title: People Controlling and Analytics Manager (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  

At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 50+ different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  

Whether you're a tech enthusiast, a payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  

Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.  

ABOUT THE TEAM

Do you want your work to create a real impact? Join our team and help take data-driven decision-making in workforce management to the next level. In this role, you will connect people data with financial metrics and transform them into valuable insights, forecasts, and recommendations for our stakeholders. 

You will work closely with Finance, People function, and other business functions to support strategic decisions related to workforce planning and efficiency improvement. With your analytical mindset and drive for continuous improvement, you will actively contribute to the development and optimization of processes, tools, and strategies. You can expect a dynamic, fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership, where your ideas matter, and you can help shape change. 


What your work will look like:

  • Own the analysis of personnel cost and FTE variances, identifying drivers, risks, and opportunities, and translating findings into clear recommendations for action. 

  • Lead workforce planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling, translating operational developments into financial impacts and strategic recommendations. 

  • Support monthly and annual closing activities within the People function, ensuring methodological consistency and audit readiness. 

  • Develop and optimize dashboards, models, and KPI frameworks relating to headcount, personnel costs, hiring, and ad hoc analyses, while driving standardization and automation. 

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and implement enhancements that increase speed, accuracy, and efficiency across analytics and controlling workflows. 

  • Collaborate closely with Payroll, Accounting, Controlling and Analytics teams to ensure high data quality, consistent KPIs, and reliable reporting. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Proven experience in Controlling, Analytics and People Analytics, particularly in forecasting, variance analysis, KPI development, and scenario modeling. 

  • Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, prioritize effectively in alignment with stakeholders, and solve complex challenges through a data-driven and AI-enabled approach. 

  • Strong expertise with analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, BI tools, or spreadsheet solutions), along with a passion for continuously improving processes, models, and analyses through automation, standardization, and AI. 

  • Ability to translate complex data into clear insights, impactful visualizations, and actionable recommendations for a variety of stakeholders across Finance, People & Culture, and Management. 

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a genuine interest in shaping and improving processes, tools, and strategies at a departmental level. 

  • High level of initiative, ownership, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. 

  • Fluency in English is required; German language skills are a strong advantage. 


What's next?

Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English or German. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  

We will get back to you within 14 days of receiving your application.   

The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 60min conversation with two stakeholders and an approx. 45min Team interview. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.

WHAT WE OFFER 

More than a workplace. A place to grow. 🌍 

At Unzer, colleagues from 50+ nationalities across four countries work together to create better outcomes for our merchants. We take ownership, move with pace and keep raising the bar—as one team. 

We set high expectations and give you the flexibility, learning opportunities and practical support to do your best work, grow your impact, and build a sustainable career. 

🏡 Flexibility that works 
Combine focused time at home with connection and collaboration in the office. Our hybrid setup includes two office days per week. 

🚲 Your commute, your choice 
Choose the mobility benefit that works for you: bike leasing or a Deutschlandticket.  

🏖️ Work from anywhere in the EU 
Change your perspective and work from another EU country for up to 15 days per year. 

📗 Keep raising the bar

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany or Hungary
description:
About Linro

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be the engineer who gets Linro running inside a customer's real environment and keeps it running. Our founders and go-to-market team win the customer and own the commercial relationship. You own the technical side: you take a customer from signed agreement to a working install and the first blocked change, and stay on it after go-live for upgrades, incidents and tuning. Part of this happens on-site: you may spend a few days at a customer's office to get an install running or to work through a problem with their team. Everything you learn goes back to engineering and product. This is an engineering role, not a support or sales role, and there is no quota.

What you will do

  • Run customer onboarding end to end: connect the customer's cloud accounts, whichever provider they run on, deploy sensors (managed, or inside the customer's own cluster) and get to a first blocked change fast.

  • Write and tune SQL-based policies and policy packs mapped to each customer's frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA), and keep false positives low.

  • Wire Linro guardrails into the customer's Terraform and CI/CD workflows and into their AI coding agents through MCP.

  • Run Linro in production at the customer: monitor, upgrade and respond when it breaks. Debug inside their environment, hand reproducible findings to engineering, and fix what you can yourself.

  • Close the loop: structured feedback to product and engineering, reusable playbooks for the next customer, and a seat in scoping calls so that what we promise is what installs.


What we are looking for

  • 5 to 6+ years of customer-facing technical delivery (forward deployed or solutions engineering, SRE or platform consulting), deploying infrastructure or security software in customer environments and keeping it running afterwards.

  • Hands-on cloud experience: you have run real workloads, identity and access, networking and audit logging on at least one major cloud, and you pick up the others quickly.

  • You are a solid engineer. You write real code in Go or Python for integrations and tooling, read Go services, and are comfortable with SQL and APIs.

  • You use AI coding agents daily, such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and have hands-on MCP experience.

  • You understand how companies work: change management, approvals, release and audit processes, and how to fit Linro into them.

  • Restricted-network experience: proxies, private networking, data residency, self-hosted or in-cluster installs.

  • Communication and comfort with ambiguity. You explain trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives, set honest expectations, and keep making progress when requirements are still unclear. Fluent English.

  • Open to travel. To customers across Europe and the US, up to roughly a quarter of your time.

Nice to have

  • Turning compliance frameworks (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) into concrete controls.

  • Policy-as-code (OPA/Rego, Sentinel, Cedar) or CSPM tooling.

How we work

We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership. You own every customer deployment from day one, with direct access to the founders and to the engineers who built what you are deploying.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other's time seriously.

The honest version

This is early. You will often be the first person to run Linro in a customer's environment, and you will write the playbooks as you go. If you want a polished onboarding process and a stable product surface, this is not it. If you want to sit between a new category and the customers who need it, and you like the idea of deploying the thing that keeps AI agents from breaking production, we should talk.

title: Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Our approach combines laser schemes for cooling/initialization/readout, engineered magnetic-field gradient induced coupling (MAGIC) combined with microwave control for universal gate sets, and advanced quantum control techniques and dedicated firmware to work within the high-fidelity regime and below the error threshold of quantum error correction (QEC).


A central objective of our technology roadmap is the realization of fault-tolerant quantum computing. To achieve this goal, we combine the above high-fidelity quantum hardware with microscopic physics-based modelling, hardware–software co-design, advanced characterization and benchmarking techniques, and detailed numerical simulations to model system performance realistically and identify the optimal QEC strategy and the associated system requirements.

As part of our initiative towards fault-tolerant quantum computing, we are expanding our Foundations & Concepts team and are looking for a Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d) to help establish and grow this strategic activity within the company.


Role Overview:

As Senior Quantum Fault-Tolerance Architect (f/m/d), you will help shaping eleQtron’s long-term roadmap towards logical quantum computing, driving research activities in quantum error correction and fault tolerance, contributing to key architectural decisions, coordinating cross-functional efforts across hardware, software, system architecture and applications, and playing a leading role in building and growing the company’s fault-tolerance capability.


Responsibilities: 

  • Develop and drive fault-tolerant quantum-computing strategies and logical architectures for trapped-ion MAGIC quantum processors.

  • Lead hardware-aware quantum error-correction studies and guide architectural decisions for future processor generations.

  • Coordinate realistic performance models connecting hardware characterization, circuit-level noise models, and logical performance metrics.

  • Work closely with System Architecture, System Operations, Software Engineering, and Quantum Applications teams to support the co-design of future fault-tolerant quantum computers.

  • Contribute to the development and mentoring of a growing fault-tolerance team while supporting eleQtron’s long-term technology roadmap.


Required Skills:

  • PhD in Physics, Quantum Information and Computation, or a closely related field.

  • Exceptional postdoctoral or industrial research experience in quantum error correction and, ideally, logical architecture design.

  • Demonstrated scientific leadership and the ability to drive independent research activities.

  • Ability to work effectively across theory, hardware, software, and engineering disciplines.

  • Fluent communication in English 

What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the game.

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being.

description:

Enterprise Solution Architect (gn)
Schwerpunkt Prozesse und Toolchain

Wie oft bekommt man die Aufgabe, Enterprise Architecture in einem Konzern nicht zu zeichnen, sondern zum Laufen zu bringen?

Architekturen entwerfen viele. Dafür sorgen, dass sie gepflegt werden, dass das Tool mit den Quellsystemen spricht und dass die Prozesse dahinter von Menschen tatsächlich befolgt werden, das können wenige. Diese Rolle ist genau dafür da. Du bist die Person, die EAM in einem Konzern vom Konzept zur täglichen Praxis macht.

Unser Mandant, ein international tätiger Dienstleistungskonzern mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, stellt seine IT gerade organisatorisch neu auf. Die IT wird gerade organisatorisch neu aufgestellt, und das Enterprise Architecture Management im Zentralbereich bekommt dabei eine eigene Rolle für das, was sonst nebenbei laufen soll und deshalb nie läuft: Methodik und Werkzeuge. Was es gibt: eine Architekturfunktion, Boards und Communities, Quellsysteme mit Daten. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht, das sich selbst trägt.

Du verantwortest die methodische und technische Grundlage des EAM. Prozesse, die so gestaltet sind, dass sie effizient bleiben.   • Du entwirfst Schulungs- und Onboarding-Konzepte für alle Tool-Nutzenden, pflegst die Anwenderdokumentation und schreibst die Leitfäden, die neue Nutzende wirklich lesen.

Arctic Research and Development (ARD) was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE

ARD is growing and we’re looking for a Junior Mechanical Engineer to support the design, build and deployment of our ruggedized hardware products - from-field ready energy systems to autonomous surface and subsurface platforms.

You'll join our mechanical engineering team, which designs, builds and tests the hardware that has to operate reliably in the Arctic. You'll report to our Lead Mechanical Engineer and work closely with our Mechanical Engineer and CTO. You'll start hands-on, building and testing units, then feed what you learn back into design updates. Within your first 6-12 months, your work will let us build and test properly, and expand bandwidth to launch further products in parallel.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and assemble product units through our first multi-unit production run, taking on hands-on workshop tasks to get units completed to standard and on schedule.

  • Run test phases alongside each build and record the results, so issues are found and fixed before units reach customers.

  • Turn what you learn on the workshop floor into design improvements, working with our Senior Mechanical Engineer on updates to parts and assemblies.

  • Produce engineering drawings and CAD models, and carry out the calculations on loads and forces that support design decisions.

  • Move on to additional products once builds of our current product are established, applying the same build, test and improvement cycle.

ABOUT YOU

You're a mechanical engineer who understands a design best by building it. You're happy doing practical work in the workshop, and you want to grow into design engineering, using what you learn hands-on to make the next version better. You might be coming from an engineering degree apprenticeship, a graduate development programme, or a technician or shop-floor role where you've started taking on design work.

REQUIREMENTS

Essential

  • A degree in mechanical engineering (BEng or above), a completed engineering degree apprenticeship, or equivalent engineering training.

  • Hands-on experience building, assembling or fabricating mechanical assemblies in a workshop or production setting.

  • Ability to understand how forces and loads act on a design and carry out engineering hand calculations.

  • Willingness to make practical build and technician work a core part of your role, alongside design work.

  • Comfortable owning tasks on a project with guidance from senior engineers, and raising problems early when a build or test doesn't go to plan.

Desirable

Every transaction we process requires a real-time decision. Declining a legitimate transaction leaves a customer stuck at the point of purchase, while approving a fraudulent one carries a direct cost.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will be part of a team that builds, ships, and maintains the entire machine learning lifecycle.

Our main focus is fraud detection and prevention, an adversarial domain where opponents constantly adapt and feedback arrives in the form of financial impact. Alongside, this we build broader capabilities to enable machine learning across Moonpay.

Decide in real time

  • Own the services that score transactions in-flight, inside a hard latency budget

  • Design the degraded paths: what we answer when the model can't, and who agreed that policy

Ship safely, continuously

  • Mature the replay, shadow and staged-rollout tooling until changing a live model is routine and reversible

Must-have experience and skills

  • Real-time serving. You have built and operated high-availability services that execute within strict latency budgets on critical paths, and you’ve designed robust fallback mechanisms

  • Systems thinking. You view the architecture holistically: identifying failure points, managing graceful degradation, and ensuring the system remains responsive even when dependencies fail. You build the feedback loops that allow a system to learn from its own decisions.

  • Engineering craft. You write code other people are happy to inherit — tested, typed, and correct when events arrive twice, late, or out of order. Adding the next feature to something you built is fast and painless.

  • Pipelines in production. You have owned feature or data pipelines end-to-end, including troubleshooting cases where offline and production metrics diverged and resolving the underlying discrepancies.

  • Ambiguity and influence. You've taken a problem nobody had scoped and turned it into work that shipped, and raised the level of the engineers around you while doing it.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Decision explainability. You've built systems where the reason for a decision mattered as much as the decision: audit trails, per-layer attribution, llm-driven analyses, or defending a model's behaviour to a non-technical audience.

  • Anomaly detection. You have developed systems to detect novel attack patterns and emerging abuse without existing labels, identifying suspicious behavior relative to historical baselines.

  • Familiarity with our stack: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Memorystore, Vertex AI, Kubernetes.

title: Security Engineer - UK - Remote
description:
Job Description

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast.

  • Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

  • You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners).

  • You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).

 

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings.

  • Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet.

  • Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support.

  • Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews.

 

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com

title: Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer
description:
Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer

Location: Budapest, Hungary

Ways of working: Hybrid
Contract: Permanent, full-time

About Hawk-Eye Innovations

Hawk-Eye Innovations is at the forefront of sports technology, delivering officiating, tracking, broadcast and performance solutions across some of the world's biggest sports. As part of Sony Sports, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation, helping athletes, coaches, teams, broadcasters and governing bodies make better decisions through technology.

Bring computer vision to the world of sport

What if athletes, coaches and teams could access the kind of tracking technology that has traditionally been out of reach?

We’re building a new generation of tracking services for elite and semi-professional sport, putting powerful computer vision technology directly into the hands of the people who need it most.

We’re looking for a Senior Android Computer Vision Engineer to help make that possible.

You’ll join a small, cross-functional engineering team building products at the cutting edge of sport and technology. With the direction set and plenty still to be built, you’ll have the autonomy to shape solutions, make important technical decisions and see your work make a real difference.

The role

You’ll own computer vision on the device, taking detection and tracking models and making them work reliably on consumer Android phones and tablets.

That means much more than getting a model to run. You’ll optimise and profile inference for real-world hardware, balancing performance with accuracy across different devices, lighting conditions and environments. You’ll work close to the camera capture pipeline, where frame timing, exposure and device behaviour can all affect the quality of the output.

Your challenge is to ensure that the data produced on a mobile device is accurate, reliable and trusted by the wider tracking system.

You’ll work closely with mobile, backend, computer vision and machine learning engineers, with the freedom to own both your technical approach and its implementation. We also embrace AI-augmented and AI-delegated development as part of how we work, enabling a small team to build and iterate at pace.

This is an opportunity to solve genuinely challenging engineering problems, influence how on-device vision is built and help establish the foundations for a technology that can change how sport is experienced and analysed.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own on-device inference: Design and implement Android inference solutions that meet demanding accuracy, latency and performance requirements.

  • Build the native Android vision layer: Develop and maintain C++ components using the Android NDK, alongside JNI bindings that connect them to our Kotlin application.

  • Optimise models for mobile: Convert, quantise, profile and optimise detection and tracking models, exploring techniques such as pruning, graph optimisation and operator-level improvements.

  • Solve real-world camera challenges: Work close to the capture pipeline, understanding how frame timing, exposure and camera behaviour influence model performance.

  • Make accuracy measurable: Build validation tools and measurement processes that demonstrate performance against ground truth in real-world conditions.

  • Engineer for real devices: Account for thermal constraints, battery consumption, hardware differences and the unpredictable conditions encountered in the field.

  • Collaborate on model improvements: Work with our computer vision and machine learning specialists to identify, prototype and evaluate improvements to model performance.

  • Shape technical decisions: Help determine what should run on-device and what should run elsewhere, bringing clear reasoning and an understanding of technical trade-offs.

  • Build production-quality software: Write maintainable, testable and reliable code that meets the team's engineering standards.

  • Work across disciplines: Communicate clearly with mobile application, backend and machine learning engineers who depend on your work.

  • Build with AI: Use AI-assisted and delegated development tools as a standard part of your workflow, working within our security and intellectual property guidelines.

As the team grows, there may also be opportunities to mentor other engineers, take technical leadership of on-device vision and establish the standards and practices that shape our approach to edge AI.

What you’ll bring

You’re an experienced computer vision or machine learning engineer who enjoys taking algorithms beyond the lab and making them work reliably in production.

You’re comfortable working close to the hardware, investigating problems that don’t show up in controlled environments and making informed trade-offs between accuracy, performance and resource consumption. You can work independently, communicate your thinking clearly and collaborate with engineers across different disciplines.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • At least 4 years of applied computer vision or machine learning engineering experience, including solutions deployed into production.

  • Demonstrable experience running inference on Android or embedded devices, rather than working exclusively with desktop or server hardware.

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • A strong interest in learning new technologies, tools and platforms.

Experience in automotive, embedded systems or other resource-constrained environments could be particularly relevant.

Technical skills

You’ll have expert-level knowledge of:

  • Applied computer vision, including object detection, tracking, camera geometry and the challenges that arise outside controlled environments.

  • Mobile or embedded inference runtimes, including model conversion and quantisation toolchains.

  • Model optimisation and performance profiling for resource-constrained hardware.

  • C++, particularly the Android NDK and JNI.

  • Measuring and validating model accuracy against ground truth.

You’ll also be comfortable with:

  • Kotlin, with enough experience to work effectively across the JNI boundary.

  • Python for prototyping, tooling and data analysis.

  • Mobile camera capture pipelines, including frame timing and exposure control.

  • Machine learning fundamentals, allowing you to contribute meaningfully to discussions about model improvements.

  • Git, code reviews and continuous integration practices.

It would be beneficial to understand:

  • Real-time and latency-sensitive systems.

  • Spatial computing and multi-view reconstruction.

  • The Android application development and release lifecycle.

You don’t need to have worked with every technology listed. We’re interested in the depth of your engineering experience, your ability to solve difficult problems and your willingness to learn.

Our technology

Our stack includes C++, Android NDK, JNI, Kotlin, Python and AWS, supported by Git, GitHub Actions, Jira and Android mobile inference and profiling tools.

Why Hawk-Eye?

At Hawk-Eye, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology used across the world's leading sports while solving complex technical challenges alongside talented engineers and product teams. You'll play a key role in shaping products from the ground up, working in an environment that values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build cutting-edge mobile products that make a genuine impact in sport, we'd love to hear from you.

Hungary Benefits

  • Annual Leave: Standard according to local labour law

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model (2 days in our office per week)

  • Access to sporting events and tickets

  • Sony Group Company Discounts

  • Other Benefits: Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card, Nursery & Kindergarten contributions, Annual MOL Bubi Pass), Private Medical Insurance, Life & Accident Insurance, MindentMent Dental Clinic discounts, Seniority Awards, Employee Assistance Program

description:

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up.   • Own the full lifecycle within your domain. Lead technically across pre-silicon, post-silicon, and sustainment — from emulation and bring-up through to production reliability and field issue resolution.

Skills & Experience

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

We are seeking a Bioinformatics Software Engineer to drive the flow cytometry data engineering infrastructure, annotation pipelines, model registry operations, and code governance for an advanced clinical biomarker discovery platform operating under machine learning industry best practices and Medical Device Machine Learning (MedDev ML) standards.

In this role, you will be responsible for translating high-dimensional flow cytometry data into reproducible, production-grade features compliant with industry best practices and MedDev ML framework requirements. Your key deliverables will include frozen, reproducible feature pipelines and locked model registry artifacts. You will oversee automated cell-type annotation, manage model artifact registries, enforce data integrity, trace compliance, and handle leakage controls across machine learning partitions while leading peer code reviews.

Core Responsibilities

  • Flow Cytometry Data Engineering & Annotation Pipelines: Execute automated cell annotation workflows on large-scale cytometry datasets; generate cell membership files, cell subset ratio tables, and automated outlier quality-control (QC) reports. Apply locked automated gating ensembles across cross-validation and evaluation partitions, tracking and recording per-patient gating exposure metrics. Establish and lock baseline models and numerical stability criteria for flow cytometry feature extraction pipelines.

  • Model Registry & Governance: Manage the formal model lifecycle registry—versioning, freezing, and locking gating ensembles and candidate predictive models in adherence with industry best practices and MedDev ML regulatory frameworks. Refit shortlisted machine learning models on expanded cohorts and execute final model freezing prior to blinded clinical evaluations. Ensure full reproducibility by committing versioned code, pinning environment specifications (Conda/Docker), and logging all random seeds and model hyperparameters.

 

  • Code Quality, Review & Data Integrity: Serve as a primary code reviewer across the computational pipeline, enforcing strict data leakage controls, data integrity checks, and modular coding standards. Participate in Independent Method Reviews (IMRs), traceability audits, and regulatory compliance verification under industry best practices and MedDev ML guidelines while interfacing closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Bio-statisticians, and Clinical Scientists.

Team and Ways of Working

Embedded in a multidisciplinary team of 4 (ML Engineers, Biostatisticians, and Clinical Scientists) reporting directly to the Lead Data Scientist.

Qualification Requirements

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Statistics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Bioengineering, or a related quantitative field.

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Programming Mastery: Fluent in Python (NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch).

  • Software Engineering & Version Control: Proven experience with software engineering best practices: Git version control, CI/CD, workflow managers (Nextflow), environment pinning (Docker), and ML artifact tracking.

  • Cytometry Knowledge: Familiarity with flow cytometry feature generation and batch-effect harmonisation.

  • Familiarity with cross-validation leakage traps in high-dimensional flow cytometry predictive modeling.

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills)

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet
At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. You'll lead important elements of our global regulatory readiness programme while supporting the development of policy positions, advocacy strategies and engagement with policymakers, regulators and industry bodies.

You'll work closely with senior leaders and teams across the business to assess emerging regulatory developments, understand their potential impact and translate complex requirements into clear, practical recommendations. Your remit will span some of the most important issues affecting the data and technology sector, including AI, data protection, financial crime, consumer protection, ESG, competition and international trade.

This is an opportunity to combine regulatory insight, public policy and business strategy in a highly visible global role, helping Dun & Bradstreet respond effectively to regulatory change while supporting responsible innovation and growth.

Based in our beautiful offices in Paddington, London, this role works on a hybrid basis with at least 3 days on site and will require occasional travel.

Regulatory Strategy & Readiness

  • Lead the assessment and prioritisation of regulatory change, working with Legal, Compliance and business stakeholders to determine appropriate actions
  • Coordinate regulatory readiness and gap assessments across priority regulatory developments
  • Translate complex regulatory changes into clear, decision-ready briefings and recommendations for senior stakeholders
  • Track regulatory risks, actions and progress, providing meaningful reporting and insights to leadership
  • Help strengthen and evolve our approach to regulatory horizon scanning and readiness across the organisation

    • Public Policy & Regulatory Affairs

  • Build strong relationships with policymakers, regulators, trade associations and other external stakeholders

title: Senior Fund Operations Manager
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

As we scale following our Series B, we are looking for a Senior Fund Operations Manager to play a key role in delivering exceptional fund operations and service quality to our customers. This is not a traditional fund administration role focused on repetitive processing.

We are looking for operators who deeply understand private markets operations, enjoy solving complexity, and want to help shape how modern fund administration should work.

You will work at the intersection of fund operations, client service, and product development - partnering closely with fund managers, investors, product teams, and internal operations functions to deliver a seamless experience across the full fund lifecycle. We are particularly looking for strong expertise in fund administration, transfer agency operations, fund onboarding, and complex post-close operational processes.

Your role

  • Act as a strategic operational partner to fund managers, supporting them across the day-to-day operations of their funds and delivering an exceptional customer experience.

  • Own and coordinate complex post-close operational processes, including capital calls, distributions, investor reporting cycles, and ongoing fund lifecycle events.

  • Lead operational execution for fund migrations and new fund launches, including the review, reconciliation, and migration of historical data from previous administrators.

  • Own capital call and distribution calculations end-to-end using our automated operational workflows, including the interpretation of LPA clauses, management fee calculations, equalisation mechanics, liquidity buffer assessments, and investor allocation logic.

  • Partner directly with fund managers to explain methodologies, align on assumptions and outputs, incorporate feedback where appropriate, and guide clients towards operationally and legally sound approaches based on fund documentation.

  • Partner with Fund Accounting to support recurring reporting cycles and ensure operational and financial data is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

  • Support treasury-related workflows, including payment coordination, invoice handling, and operational cash movement processes.

  • Act as a key point of contact for fund managers and investors, helping resolve operational queries with a high level of responsiveness and ownership.

  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to shape and improve our internal platform and operational tooling based on real customer workflows and operational pain points.

  • Help drive the evolution of our “full back-office” operating model by identifying opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and scalable operational design.

  • Support, review, and mentor more junior team members, helping establish high standards for quality, operational rigour, and client service.

  • Improve processes, workflows, and documentation across the organisation to increase scalability, transparency, and operational excellence.

About you

  • You bring 4+ years of experience in fund administration, fund operations, transfer agency, or related private markets operations environments.

  • You have strong hands-on experience managing operational fund workflows across the full lifecycle, particularly capital activity, reporting processes, and complex operational coordination.

  • You understand private markets fund structures and are comfortable reviewing LPAs, investment agreements, and related fund documentation to identify operationally relevant terms and requirements.

  • You are highly detail-oriented and able to manage complex operational processes with accuracy and ownership under tight timelines.

  • You are comfortable working cross-functionally with other Fund Accounting, Product, and client-facing teams.

  • You bring a strong service mindset and understand how operational quality directly impacts customer trust and long-term relationships.

  • You enjoy improving systems and processes and are excited by the opportunity to help modernise fund administration through technology and AI.

  • You are proactive, structured, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

  • You enjoy mentoring others and raising the operational quality bar across a team.

  • You are fluent in English; German is a plus.

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food, and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Remote-flexible hybrid (3 days/week in office)

  • Up to 6 remote calendar weeks a year

  • Work with a diverse team of 120+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring Process

  1. People Team Interview (30 min) – Meet us & check initial fit

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min) – Collaboration, ownership, and culture

  3. Case interview (45 min) + VP of Ops screen (30 min) – Collaborative problem-solving and communication skills

  4. Final Round (60 min) – Meet our Founders and senior stakeholders

  5. Reference calls to confirm your relationship building abilities

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.
